subject.title: Feature Request: Add parseMode config for Telegram channels

question: Should Telegram expose an inherited outbound formatting setting, and if so should the first supported contract be limited to upgrade-safe `html` and `plain` modes or also include MarkdownV2/raw formatting?
rationale: The choice changes public configuration and message-rendering semantics, and source inspection cannot determine the intended mode set, precedence with `richMessages`, or acceptable escaping and trust boundary.

options.title: Ship HTML and plain modes
options.body: Preserve HTML as the default, add an inherited plain-text opt-out, and defer MarkdownV2/raw formatting until a separate safe contract is designed.

options.title: Include MarkdownV2
options.body: Add HTML, plain, and MarkdownV2 together only with end-to-end escaping, caption/edit/preview parity, compatibility documentation, and live Telegram proof.

options.title: Keep renderer-managed formatting
options.body: Decline a user-selectable mode and instead fix individual HTML and rich-message rendering defects within the existing automatic delivery model.

recommendation.title: Ship HTML and plain modes
recommendation.body: Preserve HTML as the default, add an inherited plain-text opt-out, and defer MarkdownV2/raw formatting until a separate safe contract is designed.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history ties this person to the original HTML decision, recent Telegram configuration work, and prior product review of this issue.
